name: You're Alive, Phil
storyline: Help Phil work out what it means to be alive. Guide our rocky friend through 100 levels of relaxing, grid-based puzzle platforming, accompanied by atmospheric music and narration.
summary:
You're Alive, Phil, is an indie minimalist 3D puzzle game about coming to terms with your place in an indifferent universe. Help Phil navigate his sudden and unexpected existence through oodles of levels and distinct puzzle mechanics, all while listening to his story unfold.

Featuring a minimalist aesthetic, an atmospheric soundtrack, and a casual-friendly control scheme, You're Alive, Phil allows players to stretch their minds without stressing their minds.
